# Legacy quoted JSONPath names: third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/json_functions.md.
# Exercise JSON inputs; STRING inputs do not use the lax-path validator.
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_EXTRACT(value, "$['a.b']")) FROM UNNEST([JSON '{"a.b": [1,2]}']) AS value
=> "[1,2]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_EXTRACT(value, "$['a.b'][1]")) FROM UNNEST([JSON '{"a.b": [1,2]}']) AS value
=> "2"

SELECT JSON_EXTRACT(value, "$['missing']") IS NULL FROM UNNEST([JSON '{"a.b": [1,2]}']) AS value
=> "true"

SELECT SAFE.JSON_EXTRACT(value, "$['a.b'") IS NULL FROM UNNEST([JSON '{"a.b": [1,2]}']) AS value
=> "true"

# Escaping control characters in field names: GoogleSQL compliance
# testdata/strings.test (to_json_string_with_escaped_field_names).
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(x AS `a\x00b`)) FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x
=> "{\"a\\u0000b\":1}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(STRUCT(x AS `a\x00b`) AS nested)) FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x
=> "{\"nested\":{\"a\\u0000b\":1}}"

SELECT (STRUCT(x AS `a\x00b`)).`a\x00b` AS value FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x
=> "1"
